label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
designChoices: Chosen by the user: one finger paints and two fingers move the map; four detail colours; brush fixed on screen; extras: paint along a route, show what is already stored, undo, live size estimate.
changes: Offline bar has two tabs. Paint: paint the detail you want onto the 2D or 3D map. One finger paints, two fingers pan/zoom/rotate/tilt; a second finger landing within 350 ms (or 24 dp) of a stroke's start turns it into a map gesture and the stroke is reverted.

Four detail colours: Overview z13 (red), Standard z14 (orange), Detailed z15 (yellow), Maximum z17 (green), and an eraser. Painted areas are stored as zoom-16 cells (about 440 m square in NZ); each downloads every image tile from z0 to its own detail that covers it, plus terrain and (optionally) NZ Topo and overlays.
Brush fixed on screen (26 dp radius, outline shown under the finger), so zooming out paints broad areas and zooming in paints precise strips.

Undo (50 strokes; Clear is undoable), Along route (corridor 500 m either side of the open route or a saved route, as one stroke), live size and file estimate off the UI thread, 'Too large' warning above 20,000 image tiles.
The terrain tint shows painted cells in their colour and areas already stored on the phone faintly in the same colours (cache, saved rectangles and saved painted areas).

The painting is kept as a draft between sessions. After Download it becomes a saved region (cleared from the canvas, Undo restores it); saved painted regions resume with their own cells, imagery and overlay choices.
Topo map tab: the page-shaped or custom frame for NZ Topo region downloads and Save as PDF; switches the map to NZ Topo in 2D and restores the previous style when leaving.
Advanced: imagery for painted downloads (LINZ aerial or Satellite), include NZ Topo & overlays, downloaded maps only, overview imagery packs. Download progress shows tile counts only.
